title: Somalia Recurrent Cost & Reform Financing Project - Phase 3: Procurement of Consulting Services for the Development of DHIS2 Application for Ministry of Health
publisher: DevelopmentAid (notice of the Ministry of Finance, Federal Government of Somalia)
why_not: A request for expressions of interest reproduced by a tender aggregator: it names a World Bank-financed consultancy for a 'DHIS2 application' without describing it, and states nothing on plan, tiers or the last twelve months; donor finance is already held.
